**What are you trying to do that the library doesn't support today?**

**Where does this fit relative to the [roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap)?**
Is this a missing piece of an existing milestone, or a new one? If it's a large addition (a new
integration category, not a single class), a short design sketch is helpful — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for conventions to follow.

**Prior art**
Does Python LangChain (or LangChain.js) have an equivalent? Link it if so — it's the conceptual
reference for this project, even though the API shape here is intentionally idiomatic C++ rather than
a transliteration.

**Are you willing to implement this yourself?**
